idea-plugin.name: Aither — ACP + A2A integration
idea-plugin.description:
Full A2A + ACP integration from JetBrains.
  • ACP (Agent Client Protocol v2) — spawns adk acp serve --agent <name> (the awdk ACP server) and drives the agent over stdio JSON-RPC: chat prompts, session list/resume/close, and the session/request_permission human-in-the-loop approval gate.
  • A2A (Agent-to-Agent) — send signed messages to any other AitherOS agent (send_message / invoke_skill) over the mesh.
Requires the awdk CLI on PATH (adk acp serve).

action.description: Open the Aither ACP/A2A agent panel
